name: cea
mission: Makes coding agents prove compiler claims.
flowAlt: Data flow. Request: an agent over MCP stdio or a person on the cea CLI calls one of 20 tools from a single registry, and the input is checked against a strict schema that rejects flags which load code into the compiler. Run: the toolbox finds compilers and tools already installed on PATH and records their versions, each process is started from an argument array with no shell, a timeout and an output cap, and the real clang, gcc, opt, alive-tv, cvise, csmith or git does the work. Record: the result becomes an evidence record split into observed, inferred and unknown, it is appended to a JSONL ledger with raw output kept on disk, and the caller gets the record and its evidence id to cite later.
